subject: how to get ride of the top and right axis in ggplot2

messages.author: 20b73f4748706290
messages.subject: how to get ride of the top and right axis in ggplot2
parts:
Hello there,

I would like to make all axis including bottom, top, left, and right axises with heavier lines. I used the command +opts(axis.line = theme_segment(size=1.5)), but it only makes the bottom and left axis heavier without affecting the top and right axis. I need either delete these two axis or make them look same as the bottom and left axis.

Thanks

Xiaoyu

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: how to get ride of the top and right axis in ggplot2
parts:
Hi,

try panel.border:

qplot(1:3) + opts(panel.border = theme_rect(size = 3))
